candidates.name: Sunny-Yellow Openwork Shirt
candidates.decisionReason: Full-resolution proof shows a straight regular camp-shirt body, clean collar and breathable openwork texture; the sunny yellow is cheerful and Resort-specific without becoming oversized or loud.

candidates.name: Light-Blue Mandarin Tank
candidates.decisionReason: The smooth sleeveless performance-like body and beach-gym presentation read athletic rather than textured, polished Resort wear.

candidates.name: Pastel-Blue Openwork Knit Tank
candidates.decisionReason: The color and knit are attractive, but the close armholes, fitted torso and muscular styling move toward a body-focused skinny top rather than the controlled ease required here.

candidates.name: Beige Eyelet Knit Tank
candidates.decisionReason: The beige eyelet is wearable but adds no happy color and would create a washed-out pale-on-pale look with the strongest short.

candidates.name: Blue Sleeveless Knit Polo
candidates.decisionReason: It has credible relaxed ease, but the long sleeveless polo body and visible metal chest tag are less refined and less cheerful than the yellow camp shirt.

candidates.name: Khaki Openwork Collared Shirt
candidates.decisionReason: The close torso, stretched button line, long hem and horizontal brown striping make the knit look fitted and dated rather than clean modern Resort styling.

candidates.name: Light-Green Textured Henley
candidates.decisionReason: The soft green is useful, but the long rounded body, rolled sleeves and deep open neckline read beach cover-up rather than a crisp Spring Resort top.

candidates.name: Cerise Clean Short
candidates.decisionReason: Full-resolution review shows washed jersey-like fabric, a hidden elastic waist and broad basketball-style volume; the strong pink cannot compensate for the sloppy shape.

candidates.name: Fog-Purple Casual Short
candidates.decisionReason: The fog-purple color is appealing, but the long utility volume, side snap and large pocket treatment would turn the look into baggy streetwear instead of refined Resort styling.

candidates.name: Pastel-Blue Elastic Short
candidates.decisionReason: The isolated product image provides no rise, seat, leg opening or on-body length proof, and the half-elastic waistband reads generic chino.

candidates.name: Sage Casual Short
candidates.decisionReason: The product-only crop lacks on-body fit proof, while the multiple zip pockets introduce technical detailing that conflicts with the clean openwork shirt.

candidates.name: Light-Green Casual Short
candidates.decisionReason: The narrow long leg finishing at the knee and black-boot styling make this short feel conventional and heavy rather than easy Resort tailoring.

candidates.name: Khaki Casual Short
candidates.decisionReason: The heavily creased product-only image lacks body proof and makes the fabric look cheap and collapsed.

candidates.name: Navy Clean Short
candidates.decisionReason: The pressed construction is clean, but the dark navy and long conservative length would make the bright shirt look like a basic uniform rather than a fresh Resort outfit.
